jamie: Hi folks — joining the on-call rota next Monday. Quick checklist: what access/pager IDs do I need and where are the runbooks?

lena: welcome @jamie! You'll need PagerDuty access (team: redwood-runtime), membership in the SSO group `infra-oncall`, and read/write to Confluence space 'Operations Runbooks'.

oncall-bot: Automated audit: jamie missing PagerDuty team assignment. Request via https://idp.example.com/requests with manager approval.

jamie: filed request (IDP-593). While that's pending, can I shadow someone or join a mock incident?

michael: Yep — I can pair Fri 4pm PT for a mock P1. We'll run the incident play through the `oncall-sim` script and practice the handoff doc.

ops-trainer: Also sign up for the next live onboarding workshop Tue 10am PT (calendar invite sent). It covers alert triage cadence, runbook structure, and escalation ladders.

lena: Runbooks are in Confluence under /Operations/Runbooks. Start with: API rate-limiter throttles, DB failover, and cache-eviction. They include the exact commands and expected checks.

jamie: Is there a standard handoff message template? Want to make sure I include everything.

michael: yes — we use a short template. Example: 
```
SUMMARY: brief incident state
ACTIONS TAKEN: list
OPEN ITEMS: list and owners
SUPPRESSED ALERTS: list with reason
NEXT STEPS: any follow-ups and ETA
```

jamie: perfect. How long is each rotation? I read two different docs.

lena: Officially weekly, Mon 09:00 -> Mon 09:00. There is a secondary schedule for holidays and long absences (see schedule in Confluence).

jamie: How do we escalate beyond SRE? Phone tree?

oncall-bot: Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> platform -> engineering lead -> exec on-call only for Sev0. Phone numbers are in PagerDuty contact card; don't post them in public channels.

michael: Practical tip: when you get an alert, check `alerts-dashboard` then run `./scripts/check-kvs.sh` and the health endpoint before paging. Saves noise.

jamie: trying to run the sim but getting `Permission denied: /var/run/pd-token`

oncall-bot: Notice: local PD token missing for jamie. Use `pdcli auth --renew` or request a support token from infra.

jamie: `pdcli auth --renew` failed with 401. I've added infra@redwood to the IDP ticket.

lena: If infra can't issue immediately, michael can create a short-lived test token during the mock.

michael: can do. Also check that your GitHub account is in `redwood-ops` org; some runbook edits require repo write.

ops-trainer: During training we'll cover post-incident writeups and the TL;DR format we expect for postmortems. Plan to submit your first incident writeup draft after the mock.

jamie: awesome — one more question: where do we log notes during an active incident?

lena: Use the incident channel created by PD (it auto-creates a private thread) and paste the handoff template there. Also append to Confluence later.

jamie: access approved for SSO group and Confluence. Waiting on PagerDuty assignment.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty assignment completed for jamie. Welcome to redwood-runtime team.

jamie: got a test page from PD — it came through. Thanks everyone. See you at the workshop Tue and mock Fri.

michael: Good to have you. Read the last two postmortems in /incidents for common failure modes.

lena: If anything blocks you before then, DM me or @ops-trainer. :rocket:
